headerDisplay: Configure how your Kobold robot is exposed. Matter requires Homebridge 2 and must be enabled on this bridge. [Documentation](https://github.com/himbeles/homebridge-kobold#readme)

token.title: Kobold Token
token.description: Your Kobold authentication token. See the documentation for token setup instructions.

exposureMode.title: Accessory Exposure
exposureMode.description: Choose which protocols publish each robot. Restart Homebridge after changing this setting.

language.title: HomeKit Language
language.description: Language used for the HomeKit service names and Siri commands. This does not affect Matter.

hidden.title: Hidden HomeKit Services
hidden.description: Hide selected switches and sensors from the HomeKit accessory. Matter clusters are not affected.

refresh.title: Refresh Interval
refresh.description: Use auto, 0 to disable, or a number of seconds (minimum 60). Matter auto mode polls every 60 seconds while active and 120 seconds while idle.

layout.title: Kobold Account
layout.description: Connection details used to discover your Kobold robots.

layout.title: Accessory Exposure
layout.description: Choose how each robot is published to smart-home controllers.

items.helpvalue:
HomeKit + Matter: Publishes both versions. The HomeKit version appears in the Homebridge Accessories screen and retains HomeKit-only controls. The Matter version works with Matter controllers. Pairing both versions to the same home can create duplicate robot tiles.

HomeKit only: Publishes the established HomeKit accessory with the widest feature coverage and Homebridge UI control, but no Matter accessory.

Matter only: Publishes only the native Matter robotic vacuum. Matter accessories do not appear in the Homebridge Accessories screen and must be managed with Apple Home or another Matter controller. HomeKit-only controls such as schedules, No-Go lines, Extra Care, and spot dimensions are unavailable.

Matter requires Homebridge 2, Matter enabled on this bridge, and working mDNS and IPv6. Controllers may warn that the Homebridge Matter accessory is uncertified.
Find the Matter pairing code after restarting: open Plugins → Homebridge Kobold → ⋮ Actions → External Accessories. Select a robot to view its QR code, manual pairing code, and pairing status.

layout.title: HomeKit Exposure
layout.description: These options apply only when HomeKit exposure is enabled.

layout.description: Control how often robot state is refreshed from the Kobold service.
